source.debug_selection: Earliest saved earnings exhibit for each symbol by announcement date, then accession-matched primary filing if needed; no post-outcome selection

parser.table_grid: Preserve nested-table boundaries and expand rowspans/colspans into a coordinate grid without treating duplicated span cells as independent source cells
parser.header_binding: Bind row-title and precise numeric-column title; repeated headers may open a new subtable; never use same amount somewhere in row as exact-column proof
parser.scope_binding: Period, unit and accounting basis apply only within explicit structural or chapter scope; new explicit declaration closes the prior scope; conflicting scope remains unresolved
parser.footnote_binding: Use explicit HTML links/markers and table-region scope; repeated numeric markers across tables alone cannot establish a link

adapter.character_count: Python len() of final serialized Unicode model-visible input including all IDs, references, labels and newlines
adapter.context_sharing: Serialize each needed public context once per event and reference it with a stable ID; reference target must be in the visible input
adapter.group_completeness: Only a numeric cell with exact row and column relation plus all necessary reachable context is selectable; otherwise omit whole group and record reason
adapter.selection: First eligible complete group per fixed financial topic, then remaining complete groups by exhibit precedence, document and source-coordinate stable order

evaluation.reference: Frozen 71-candidate same-team review with 60 SOURCE_SUPPORTED and 11 AMBIGUOUS; source judgment immutable
evaluation.legacy_fragment_metric: Use unchanged old/v2.1/v2.2 fragment-retention definition for comparable counts
evaluation.new_structure_metric: Separately assess fragment presence, model-visible reference reachability, exact numeric-cell-to-field relation and CODEX_REVIEW source semantic support
evaluation.legacy_structure_status: UNEVALUABLE if an old output lacks structural lineage; never mark an absent schema as a structural error
evaluation.known_fields_vs_all_fields: Keep known-field completeness separate from full completeness where source accounting basis is unknown
evaluation.regression_policy: Report every old-complete/new-incomplete item, wrong binding and unresolved relation without post-score retuning

disclosure: Rules are developed on saved training material after prior validation exposure. The two earliest exhibits are structural debugging cases, not an independent test. The remaining training files are regression checks.
